(currently down to 3,500) | chairman = Ivan Stanchev | manager = [[Tsvetan Iliev]] | league = [[Third Amateur Football League (Bulgaria)|Third League]] | season = [[2024–25 Third Amateur Football League (Bulgaria)|2024-25]] | position = [[Third Amateur Football League (Bulgaria)|Third League]], 3rd | website = https://fcvolovshumen.com/ | pattern_la1 = | pattern_b1 = | pattern_ra1 = | leftarm1 = FAE652 | body1 = FAE652 | rightarm1 = FAE652 | shorts1 = 2970BA | socks1 = 2970BA | pattern_la2 = | pattern_b2 = | pattern_ra2 = | leftarm2 = FFFFFF | body2 = FFFFFF | rightarm2 = FFFFFF | shorts2 = 2970BA | socks2 = 2970BA }} '''Football Club Volov Shumen 2007''' ({{langx|bg|Футболен Клуб Волов Шумен 2007}}) is a [[Bulgaria]]n football club, playing in the city of [[Shumen]], which currently competes in [[Third Amateur Football League (Bulgaria)|Third League]], third tier of Bulgarian football. The club was established in 1929 under the name "Panayot Volov", and folded its senior team in 2014, before being 'refounded' in July 2018. In 2024 Volov merged with Shumen 2007 to form Volov Shumen 2007. Shumen plays their home games on "Panayot Volov” stadium, with a historic capacity of 24,390 people and a current one of 3,500. The team's first kit colors are yellow and blue. Because of the city's famous brand of [[Shumensko]] beer, they are often affectionately called '''Пивоварите''', or ''The Brewers''."}}
